name: p16b_0817
why: P16b. A rolling window cannot separate a PREDICATE gain from a drift in what people ate. Re-run with `--population p16b_0817` to measure this exact set. M1.1 (2026-08-18): the id list was POINTERS and shrank when user 26 deleted rows 3016/3017 live. The fixture now carries INPUT FACTS: ledger `created` events REPLAYED through `updated` events (both payload shapes: changes{} and flat merge{}) up to the freeze instant — the state the 08-17 baseline measured (55 rows had been corrected before the freeze). Verified against all 359 surviving live rows: 358 byte-equal; entry 2674 differs with NO ledger event (an unledgered production mutation, recorded here and reported to the board); its live value is taken because that is what the baseline saw. 3016/3017 recovered from the immutable ledger.
